## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (typecheck, tests, bundle, manifest validation)
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, client IDs/secrets or `.env` files included

- [ ] Scopes unchanged (or the PR explains why a new one is needed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
